summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that prize-fighter Ben Hogan was shot and mortally wounded by saloon-keeper James Jourdan at Bisbee, Arizona, noting Hogan had been beaten by Tom Allen in short order at Omaha.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, March 12, 1881, page 6

facts.fact: Allen defeated Ben Hogan in short order at Omaha

notes: Fight date not given in the article.
